requirements.description: Prove the full forward-error theorem for every model, coefficient list, and real evaluation point.
Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
Define the stated error envelope using exact values and u, with the requested recurrence and base case.
Bound the absolute difference of the supplied rounded and exact evaluators by the supplied envelope.
Use the supplied relative-error model without additional smallness, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic premises.

defect_categories.description: The requested final proposition is not proved.
A requested construction has no actual definition.
A construction differs from the specified algorithm or recurrence.
The proof is about the wrong quantity or does not connect to the construction.
The asserted error bound is weaker than or different from the requested bound.
The theorem adds a premise absent from the task.
The desired conclusion or an equivalent statement is assumed.
The theorem covers fewer inputs than the task requires.
